verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM offers agents, custom agent skills, and MCP compatibility, but there is no evidence of it embedding or supervising real coding agents that clone repos, edit files, and run tests — its agent capabilities are limited to web scraping, custom skills, and RAG workflows. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of repo cloning, code editing, test execution, or integration with coding-agent tools like Aider/Copilot within AnythingLLM.
